Senses.Explanation: The bamboo-switch wording covers three observable deployments: physically striking with the switch, presenting the switch as the point of a test, and later raising that earlier switch case for comment. An occurrence is not treated as a fresh blow when its clause merely cites or comments on the established switch case.
